title: The Two Fellows and the Bear
summary: Two men sold a bear's skin to a furrier before hunting the animal. Entering the woods, a giant bear charged them, forcing one up a tree and the other flat on the earth....
keywords: the two fellows and the bear
full_text:
Two men sold a bear's skin to a furrier before hunting the animal. Entering the woods, a giant bear charged them, forcing one up a tree and the other flat on the earth.

When the bear departed, the man in the tree laughed: "What did he tell you?"

"He said: never sell a bear's hide until you have caught the beast!"
moral: Do not sell the bear’s skin before you have brought down the beast.
